scope: Independent infrastructure source/documentary audit only; not manuscript review, host discovery, root reception or execution authority.

observations.title: Supplementary seed contexts are not all independently fixed by the author validator
observations.deduction: The author helper independently fixes programs for the first ten seeds but reconstructs later commands and emitter bytes from later seed declarations. A coordinated hypothetical change to config_bibtex_texmf.program in the declarative/source data is therefore not rejected by those particular predicates. Current actual program is correctly bibtex; this audit independently checked all 19 name/program/engine triples and all 53 ordered commands.
observations.required_interpretation: Do not advertise the helper as a complete adversarial or independent semantic check of every supplementary program context.
observations.future_reuse_recommendation: Before reusing the helper to accept revised frontier data, explicitly validate every seed label/name/program/engine/required tuple from the independently received source contract.

observations.title: Companion-interface and capture/selector validation is selective, not closed-world
observations.deduction: The helper validates existing *_authorized keys by iteration without requiring their complete key set, and omits explicit assertions for option_semantics_accepted, schema/status, science/review/visual/external fields. Its capture/selector predicates cover selected stages, counters and values rather than all required fields and exact key sets. Deletion of an iterated key is not ruled out by those predicates. All current actual fields are correctly disabled/null; full emitter-byte equality remains meaningful but does not close every companion contract.
observations.required_interpretation: The archived 2321-check result is accepted only as its actual bounded documentary checks, not a comprehensive mutation-resistant contract validator.
observations.future_reuse_recommendation: Receive a closed-world companion schema and required key sets before operationalizing or revising these contracts; keep independent full source/contract reception.

Installed help/version and generator/option semantics must be received before any filename/variable lookup. Literal no-mktex proposals are not proof of support.

Class/kernel/NFSS font/metric/VF/map, format-source provenance, configuration/database/native-renderer and actual build-cwd frontiers remain open.
